#/components/schemas/Observation.comment: phenomenonTime, result and resultTime are mandatory in the standard, but a client may omit them on POST and the service fills them in (resultTime may become null). This is why resultTime allows null.

#/components/schemas/Observation/propert.comment: The standard says DQ_Element (ISO 19157) with multiplicity zero-to-many and gives no JSON shape, so items is left open.

#/components/schemas/Datastream.source: Table 10 (properties) and Table 11 (relations). Navigation links (Thing@iot.navigationLink and similar) are not modelled.

#/components/schemas/Datastream/properti.comment: Table 12 lists only 'some' value codes, so the schema does not restrict the value to an enum.

#/components/schemas/UnitOfMeasurement.comment: SHOULD follow UCUM, not SHALL. The example uses definition http://unitsofmeasure.org/ucum.html#para-30 with symbol and name for degree Celsius.

#/paths/~1Datastreams({datastreamId})~1O.comment: SensorThings is defined by URL patterns plus OData query options ($filter, $expand, $top and so on), not by an OpenAPI document. Only this one navigation path is expressed here.
